item.title: Bennu asteroid analysis suggests unexpected origins for organics in space
item.description: Samples from the Bennu asteroid, which is currently more than 200 million miles (322 million kilometers) from Earth, and the Murchison meteorite, which fell to Earth in 1969, both contain molecules that build proteins necessary for life. item.title: A standard shortcut, used since the 1970s, hides a magneto-optic effect in ordinary glass fiber
item.description: For more than 50 years, engineers have described light in optical fiber using a convenient shortcut, one that works so well it is rarely questioned. A magnet placed beside a multimode fiber, rather than along it, can change the light traveling inside. Fuente: Phys.org.
